title: SOHCAHTOA
text: Tangent is opposite over hypotenuse, or sine over cosine. \n In the image below: A coordinate plane showing a point in the first quadrant at $$4$$ comma $$3$$. A diagonal line segment connects the origin to this point. A unit circle is centered at the origin. The angle between the positive x-axis and this line segment is labeled theta. A dashed line drops vertically from the point $$4$$ comma $$3$$ down to the horizontal axis to make the right triangle with angle theta more apparent.\n##figure4.gif##
